description:
Ji Eun-Soo was unilaterally divorced by her husband Yu Tae-Han three years ago.
She believed she was over it—no longer caring who he dated or remarried.

That is, until she finds out he's planning to marry Yu Jeong-Ha—the very woman she spent her whole life envying.

Driven by anger and desperation, Ji Eun-Soo decides to sabotage the wedding by spending a night with her ex-husband.
